Exported Functions

group PPT_SYNC_Exported_Functions

Functions

void sync_init(sync_role_t role)

Initialize the protocol.

The protocol will initiate some default settings. After initialization, the app can set some parameters before sync_enable to the value they like.

Parameters:

role -- [in] Protocol role.

void sync_crc_set(uint8_t crc_len, uint32_t crc_poly, uint32_t crc_init)

Set the crc parameters.

The protocol will initiate CRC8 as default settings. After initialization, the app can use this api to overwrite the default settings.

  • Example usage 

    // set crc8
sync_crc_set(8, 0x07, 0xff);
// set crc16
sync_crc_set(16, 0x8005, 0xffff);
// set crc24
sync_crc_set(24, 0x00065b, 0x555555);
// set crc32
sync_crc_set(32, 0x04c11db7, 0xffffffff);

Parameters:

  • crc_len -- [in] Length of CRC bit, only 8-bit integer multiple supported.

  • crc_poly -- [in] CRC polynomial.

  • crc_init -- [in] CRC initial value.

bool sync_time_set(sync_time_param_t type, uint32_t time)

Set timing related parameters.

Parameters:

  • type -- [in] Time type.

  • time -- [in] Time value, the unit is depend on the type, usually is us.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Unknown time type.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_time_get(sync_time_param_t type, uint32_t *time)

Get timing related parameters.

Parameters:

  • type -- [in] Time type.

  • time -- [out] Time value, the unit is depend on the type, usually is us.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Unknown time type.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_channel_set(uint8_t chan_num, uint8_t group_num, uint16_t freq[])

Set rf channels.

All channels are divided into several groups. Channels in a group will be used for the sync fast progress to get a new channel candidate. All channels are used in the sync slow progress to get a new channel candidate.

Parameters:

  • chan_num -- [in] Number of rf channels.

  • group_num -- [in] Number of groups.

  • freq -- [in] Array of frequencys.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Invalid parameter.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_tx_power_set(bool dynamic, int8_t tx_power_dbm_max, int8_t tx_power_dbm_min)

Set rf tx power.

If dynamic is true, the tx power will be changed automatically at the range according to the link quality. If dynamic is false, the tx_power_dbm_max will be used all the time.

Parameters:

  • dynamic -- [in] Whether to change automatically at run time.

  • tx_power_dbm_max -- [in] Maximum tx power.

  • tx_power_dbm_min -- [in] Minimum tx power.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- If tx_power_dbm_max < tx_power_dbm_min.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_log_set(uint8_t level, bool on)

Turn on/off sync log.

Parameters:

  • level -- [in] The log level. Not used currently.

  • on -- [in] True: on, false: off.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Invalid parameter.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_pair_rssi_set(int8_t rssi)

Set the RSSI threshold when pairing.

Only the requesting device with rssi value equal or bigger than the threshold will be accepted.

Parameters:

rssi -- [in] The rssi level.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Invalid parameter.

Returns:

Result.

bool sync_tifs_set(uint8_t level, uint8_t tifs)

Set time of inter-frame space (tifs).

The tifs used at different processes or sync intervals may be different. There are 2 levels used: Level 0 is used for sync slow process and sync interval >= 500us. Level 1 is used for sync interval < 500us.

Parameters:

  • level -- [in] level index

  • tifs -- [in] time of inter-frame space

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- If level is bigger than 1.

Returns:

Result.

int sync_acc_check(sync_acc_t acc)

Check whether the access address is valid.

The access address is used by the hardware to match the right packet with the same access address. The hardware has some limitations on the value of the access address. Usually it is randomly generated and checked until it is valid.

Parameters:

acc -- [in] The access address value.

Return values:

  • 0 -- Address is valid.

  • other -- Address is invalid.

Returns:

Check result.

void sync_acc_set_br(sync_acc_t acc_br)

Set the access address of the broadcast channel used by the pairing process.

Invoke this API will overwrite the default value. The user should check whether the new value is valid by calling sync_acc_check.

Parameters:

acc_br -- [in] The access address value.

void sync_enable(void)

Enable the protocol.

It shall be called after sync_init to enable the protocol.

void sync_event_cb_reg(sync_event_cb_t cb)

Register event callback function.

The event sync_event_t includes the pairing and connection result.

Parameters:

cb -- [in] Event callback.

sync_err_code_t sync_nvm_get_bond_info(sync_bond_info_t *bond_info)

Get bond information from flash.

After pairing, the bond information will be stored to the flash automatically. The bond information is used for connection.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- Bond information get successfully.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_NOT_FOUND -- Bond information doesn't exist.

Returns:

Result.

sync_err_code_t sync_nvm_set_bond_info(sync_bond_info_t *bond_info)

Set bond information to flash.

The app may want to add bond information manually by this API.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- Bond information set successfully.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_UNKNOWN -- Bond information storage fail.

Returns:

Result.

sync_err_code_t sync_nvm_clear_bond_info(void)

Clear bond information in flash.

The app can clear the bond information to restore unpaired state.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- Bond information set successfully.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_UNKNOWN -- Bond information clear fail.

Returns:

Result.

sync_err_code_t sync_pair(void)

Start pairing.

During pairing, the pairing state is at SYNC_PAIR_STATE_PAIRING state, the connection state is at SYNC_STATE_SYNC_SLOW state, util pairing progress success or fail. After pairing, two new devices are connected and bonded. The pairing result is notified at the event callback registered by sync_event_cb_reg.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- Success.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_INVALID_STATE -- Pairing state or connection state is not idle.

Returns:

Result.

sync_err_code_t sync_connect(sync_bond_info_t *bond_info)

Start connect.

If two bonded devices are disconnected, call this API to connect them. The connection result is notified at the event callback registered by sync_event_cb_reg.

Parameters:

bond_info -- [in] Pointer of bond information used to create a connection.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- Success.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_NULL_POINTER -- Input parameter bond_info is null.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_INVALID_STATE -- The connection state is not idle.

Returns:

Result.

void sync_stop(void)

Stop the connection or the pairing procedure.

If the device is connecting, pairing or connected, call this API to stop.

void sync_deinit(void)

De-initiate the protocol to release all resources.

If the device is running, the API sync_stop shall be called before this.

void sync_dlps_init(void)

Initialize the sync protocol DLPS setting.

void sync_msg_set_quota(uint8_t msg_quota[SYNC_MSG_TYPE_NUM])

Set message queue size of each type.

Different message types have independent queue sizes.

Parameters:

msg_quota -- [in] Array of queue sizes.

bool sync_msg_set_quota_by_type(sync_msg_type_t type, uint8_t quota)

Set message queue size of the specific type.

Different message types have independent queue sizes.

Parameters:

  • type -- [in] The message type

  • quota -- [in] The queue size.

Return values:

  • True -- Success.

  • False -- Invalid type.

Returns:

Result.

void sync_msg_set_finite_retrans(uint8_t msg_retrans_num)

Set message retransmit times for SYNC_MSG_TYPE_FINITE_RETRANS type of messages.

Parameters:

msg_retrans_num -- [in] Retransmit times.

void sync_msg_set_dynamic_retrans(uint8_t msg_retrans_num_lower, uint8_t msg_retrans_num_upper)

Set message retransmit times for SYNC_MSG_TYPE_DYNAMIC_RETRANS type of messages.

When the actual transmit times is between the lower limit and the upper limit, the message will give up retransmission if there are other pending messages.

Parameters:

  • msg_retrans_num_lower -- [in] Retransmit times lower limit.

  • msg_retrans_num_upper -- [in] Retransmit times upper limit.

void sync_msg_reg_receive_cb(sync_msg_receive_cb_t cb)

Register message receive callback function.

Parameters:

cb -- [in] Callback function.

sync_err_code_t sync_msg_send(sync_msg_type_t type, uint8_t *data, uint16_t len, sync_msg_send_cb_t send_cb)

Send message.

The first byte of data buffer shall contain the opcode starting from SYNC_OPCODE_APP_START_VALUE.

Parameters:

  • type -- [in] Type of the message, different types have different retransmit behavior.

  • data -- [in] Pointer of the data.

  • len -- [in] Length of the data.

  • send_cb -- [in] Callback function called when send complete.

Return values:

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_SUCCESS -- The message is successfully pushed into the queue to send.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_INVALID_PARAM -- The type of the message is not supported, or the data pointer is null.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_INVALID_LENGTH -- The length of the message is zero or exceed the limit.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_FULL_QUEUE -- The queue of this type is full.

  • SYNC_ERR_CODE_UNKNOWN -- Memory leakage may happen.

Returns:

Result.

uint8_t sync_msg_get_available_number(sync_msg_type_t type)

Get the number of free space in the message queue with the specific type.

Parameters:

type -- [in] Type of the message.

Returns:

Number of free space in the message queue.

uint8_t sync_msg_flush(sync_msg_type_t type)

Flush the message queue.

Each type of messages can be flushed independently. Use SYNC_MSG_TYPE_ALL to flush all the messages.

Parameters:

type -- [in] Type of the message.

Returns:

Number of flushed messages.

void sync_msg_reset(void)

Reset the message tx queue.

It is safe to be called when the device is disconnected and at the app task context.

uint32_t sync_enter_critical(void)

Enter critical section.

Returns:

Interrupt mask.

void sync_exit_critical(uint32_t flag)

Exit critical section.

Parameters:

flag -- [in] Interrupt mask attained from sync_enter_critical.

void sync_hb_reg_cb(sync_hb_cb_t cb)

Register heartbeat callback.

The callback is called when the heartbeat enter and exit.

Parameters:

cb -- [in] Pointer of the callback function.

void sync_rte_req_reg_cb(sync_rte_req_cb_t cb)

Register real time environment callback.

When the stack requires real time environment at special scenarios, the app shall try their best to provide. For example, avoid using critical section, avoid entering DLPS, and increase cpu clock etc.

Parameters:

cb -- [in] Pointer of the callback function.

void sync_fast_skip_lost_chan_set(bool enable)

Set whether to skip the channel where sync lost happens when hopping at sync fast state.

Parameters:

enable -- [in] Turn on/off this policy, default off.
